title: A Collage Showing 49 Drill Holes Made by NASA’s Curiosity Mars Rover
caption:
NASA's Curiosity rover has drilled 49 individual 16-millimeter holes across the surface of Mars. A close-up camera on its robotic arm photographed each bore site after dropping pulverized bedrock into the rover's internal analytical instruments.

Source: Science - A Collage Showing 49 Drill Holes Made by NASA’s Curiosity Mars Rover
